Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Terms and Conditions 1. The bidder shall visit the Institute premises before submitting the bid to inspect the installation site and assess the site conditions. No subsequent claims arising from failure to inspect the site shall be entertained. No TA/DA shall be paid for the site inspection. . The bidder shall collect a visit f orm from the FIC Store and Purchase, during the inspection visit. The duly signe d form must be uploaded along with the bid documents. Only those bids that in clude this signed form will be considered for evaluation 2. The bidder shall have relevant experience in the supply and installation of solar street lights and sha ll submit details of previous similar works, wherever required by the Institute. 3. The bidder shall submit valid GST registration and PAN details along with the bid documents. 4. The bidder shall supply, install, test, and commission 18 W solar LED street lights, complete with compatible solar panels, batteries, charge controllers, mounting arrangements, wiring, and all other accessories necessary for proper functioning. 5. Each solar street light shall be installed on a 6 m long GI pole having a minimum outer diamet er of 75 mm and a minimum wall thickness of 1.2 mm. The pole shall be erected with at least 1 m embedded below ground level and securely fixed in position using an adequate concrete found ation to ensure stability and vertical alignment. 6. The bidder shall provide a minimum three-year warranty from the date of successful installation, testing, commissioning, and acceptance by the Institute. The warranty shall cover defects in materi als, workmanship, solar panels, batteries, LED luminaires, charge controllers, and other supplied co mponents. Repair or replacement of defective components during the warranty period shall be carri ed out at no additional cost to the Institute. 7. Throughout the entire three-year warranty period, the bidder shall undertake preventive maintenan ce and inspection once every quarter. Each visit shall include cleaning of the solar panels and ins pection of the solar street light system, including the LED luminaire, battery, charge controller, elect rical connections, wiring, GI pole, mounting arrangements, and concrete foundation. Any defects ide ntified during inspection shall be rectified by the bidder at no additional cost to the Institute. 8. The bidder shall submit a quarterly maintenance report to the Institute after each inspection visit, d etailing the condition of the solar street lights, cleaning and maintenance activities performed, defe cts identified, and corrective measures undertaken. the performance security will only be release af ter sucesfull complition of all the quarterly maintenance visits. 9. All supplied materials and installation work shall conform to applicable Indian Standards, electrical s afety requirements, and relevant OEM specifications and installation guidelines. 10. Payment shall be released only after successful supply, installation, testing, commissioning, and ver ification of the solar street lights by the Institute. No advance payment shall be made. 11. The bidder shall complete the work within the time stipulated in the work order and shall ensure tha t the installation site is left clean and free from construction debris and surplus materials.

12. The bidder shall ensure that all solar street lights are fully functional at the time of handover. The In stitute reserves the right to inspect the materials, verify compliance with the prescribed specificatio ns, and reject any item or installation that does not meet the tender requirements. .
